# Implementation Plan: Frontend Foundation — API Layer + Types + Services + SignalR + Shared Components

**Branch**: `001-frontend-foundation` | **Date**: 2026-06-22 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-frontend-foundation/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by `/speckit.plan`. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

## Summary

Build the complete frontend foundation layer for the Athary e-learning platform. This phase replaces all mock data with real backend API integration by creating: a centralized API client with HTTP-only cookie auth and automatic token refresh, 23 per-domain TypeScript type files matching backend DTOs exactly, 22 typed service files in feature-based directories, a SignalR integration for real-time notifications and messaging, 4 shared UI components (Pagination, Skeleton, ErrorFallback, EmptyState), 16 TanStack Query hooks, and co-located unit tests for all services and hooks with ≥80% line coverage.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript 5+ (strict mode, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`)

**Primary Dependencies**: React 19, Vite 6, Axios (HTTP client), TanStack Query v5 (data fetching/caching), @microsoft/signalr (real-time), Zustand (client state), sonner (toasts), Vitest + React Testing Library (testing)

**Storage**: No client-side storage for tokens (HTTP-only cookies set by backend). Zustand stores for UI state only.

**Testing**: Vitest (unit + component), React Testing Library (component), @testing-library/user-event (interactions)

**Target Platform**: Modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). RTL layout (Arabic-first).

**Project Type**: Web application (React SPA)

**Performance Goals**: Initial JS bundle ≤ 200KB gzipped. API client timeout 15s. SignalR reconnection backoff 0–30s.

**Constraints**: No `any` types. No Redux. No `localStorage` for tokens. All services must use centralized API client. All shared components must support dark mode. Feature-based directory structure.

**Scale/Scope**: 22 service files, 23 type files, 16 hooks, 4 shared components, 2 SignalR hubs, ~38 test files (22 services + 16 hooks).

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| I. Code Quality & Clean Architecture | ✅ PASS | Feature-based dirs, strict TypeScript, no `any`, branded types, files <300 lines |
| II. Backend Integration & State Management | ✅ PASS | All HTTP via service modules, TanStack Query for server state, SignalR for real-time, DTOs mirror backend |
| III. Testing Standards | ✅ PASS | Vitest for unit, co-located tests, ≥80% coverage, mock at service boundary |
| IV. User Experience Consistency | ✅ PASS | Dark mode support, skeletons (not spinners), ErrorBoundary, sonner toasts |
| V. Performance Requirements | ✅ PASS | Code splitting, bundle budget enforced, virtual scrolling available |

**Result**: All gates PASS. No violations to justify.

**Structure Decision**: Feature-based architecture per constitution. Each domain gets its own feature module with a `services/` subdirectory. Shared hooks live in `features/common/hooks/`. Shared UI components live in `components/shared/`. Types live in `types/api/` with one file per domain. The centralized API client lives in `lib/api.ts`.
